result:
The fix is commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc` (PR #2731, "(fix) O3-5958: Default the queue location to the one selected in Service Queues"). It changes the new queue entry form's default `queueLocation` to the location the Service Queues dashboard has selected, falling back to the session location. The ancestor resolution that the dashboard uses was already in place and is not part of this commit.

**The fix**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.component.tsx`, lines 68 and 81. Line 68 reads `selectedQueueLocationUuid` from the store. Line 81 seeds the form with `selectedQueueLocationUuid ?? sessionLocation?.uuid ?? ''`, where the old code used only the session location.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/create-queue-entry/queue-fields/queue-fields.test.tsx`, lines 224–238. Two new tests cover prefilling from the store and falling back to the session location.

**How the dashboard picks the ancestor (already present)**

- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/patient-queue-header/queue-location-header-title.component.tsx`, lines 35–41. It resolves the login location if it is queue-tagged, otherwise the nearest queue-tagged ancestor, otherwise null.
- Same file, lines 43–68. It writes that result to the store once per login location via `updateSelectedQueueLocationUuid(resolvedDefault.uuid)` at line 56.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/hooks/useSessionLocationAncestry.ts`, lines 9–34. It walks the FHIR `partOf` chain from the login location up to the root.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-management/packages/esm-service-queues-app/src/store/store.ts`, lines 45–48 (the setter) and lines 22–29 (the store's initial state, read from session storage).

**Commit and ticket**

- Commit `1f4098170806704451ed195a9922dc1a30ebcedc`, in `openmrs-esm-patient-management`, authored by Mutagubya Jonathan, with a co-author from Nethmi Rodrigo. Its message says "ensure queueLocation defaults to sessionLocation asynchronously", but the diff I pulled only touches `queue-fields.component.tsx` and its test.

Verification: I read the code and the commit diff only. I did not run the test suite.
